_meta.what: FROZEN ARCHIVE of the Phase-0 (v0.2 / v0.2.1) dispute set, kept so that the v1.0 build can quote what each closed dispute USED to say without depending on the live file it overwrites. Created 2026-08-29 during the v1.0 rebuild, after the first build run consumed and replaced glossary_alien.disputes.json in place.
_meta.do_not_edit: Append-only history. The live file is glossary_alien.disputes.json.
_meta.spine_at_the_time: zh.wikipedia (level 1 of the OLD priority list). Superseded 2026-08-29 by the owner's settled ladder in PROJECT.md §1.4.

D1-panic-roll.why_open: cn.json disagrees with itself: its UI keys use 恐慌 for Panic while its human-translated panic-table prose renders the phrase 'Panic Roll' as 混乱检定. One of the two has to give.

D2-engaged.why_open: cn.json uses ONE string, 近战, for two different game terms: the Engaged range band and the Melee weapon type. In the weapon-type dropdown and the range dropdown the player sees the same word for two unrelated things.

D3-stress-level.why_open: Both renderings are in cn.json, both in stratum A, and both in stratum B. There is no clean stratum split to arbitrate on — only a count.

D4-health.why_open: Three renderings coexist in one file. 健康 actually has the higher English-gated count, so the provisional winner is chosen on stratum, not on count.

D5-synthetic.why_open: The system file and the film reference works disagree, and the subtitle corpus — cited by the survey as supporting 生化人 with 13 hits — does not actually support it once the count is English-gated.

D6-queen.why_open: The corpus splits by film, and English-gating narrows the margin to 4-3. zh.wikipedia breaks the tie for the compound (异形女王) but its own 异形2 article uses a third form.

D7-weyland-yutani.why_open: Three renderings from three registers, and the only one attested in this project's own corpus is the one nobody proposes.

D8-shift.why_open: Shift is BOTH a time unit the rules count in AND a bare English literal the Critical-Injury heal-time parser compares against. cn.json renders the time unit two different ways in two different places while leaving the parser literal English.
D8-shift.known_defect_in_this_archived_text: Its do_not_confuse_with field cited actor.mjs:1888 for the bare 'Shift' literal. The literal is at :1890; :1888 is the ALIENRPG.Permanent comparison. The same wrong anchor had already been corrected in the provenance file and was left uncorrected here — which is why the v1.0 build derives every anchor from source instead of quoting one.

D9-armor-piercing.why_open: The provisional value overrides a lang value that is not obviously wrong, only wrong in part of speech. Any override of a shipped string is an owner call.
